canary-180m-flash.description: 速度極快。支援英語、德語、西班牙語、法語。支援翻譯。

canary-1b-v2.name: Canary 1B v2
canary-1b-v2.description: 準確的多語言模型。25種歐洲語言。支援翻譯。

cohere-int8.name: Cohere

channel.description: 選擇要錄音的輸入聲道。如果您的音訊介面有多個輸入，請使用此選項。

audioFeedback.label: 聲音回饋
audioFeedback.description: 錄製開始和停止時播放聲音

outputDevice.description: 選擇用於聲音回饋的音訊輸出裝置

experimentalToggle.description: 啟用仍在開發中的實驗性功能

lazyStreamClose.label: 在轉錄之間保持麥克風開啟
lazyStreamClose.description: 錄音停止後保持麥克風串流開啟30秒，減少連續轉錄時的延遲。啟用時可能會降低藍牙音訊品質。

transcribe.title: Whisper 加速
transcribe.description: Whisper 模型的硬體加速。自動模式在可用時使用 GPU（macOS 上使用 Metal，Windows/Linux 上使用 Vulkan）。

ort.title: ONNX 加速
ort.description: ONNX 模型的硬體加速（Parakeet、Canary、Moonshine 等）。Windows 上的 DirectML 為實驗性功能。模型可能無法正常轉錄。

startHidden.label: 隱藏啟動
startHidden.description: 啟動至系統匣而不開啟視窗

autostart.label: 開機啟動
autostart.description: 登入電腦時自動啟動 Oshabe

showTrayIcon.label: 顯示系統匣圖示
showTrayIcon.description: 在系統匣中顯示 Oshabe 圖示

style.title: 懸浮窗
style.description: 選擇錄音懸浮窗的樣式：「無」會隱藏懸浮窗，「精簡」顯示小巧的膠囊狀指示，「即時」在您說話時即時顯示轉錄內容（僅限支援串流的模型——請在模型選擇器中尋找「串流」標籤）。在 Linux 上建議選擇「無」

position.title: 懸浮窗位置
position.description: 在錄製和轉錄期間顯示視覺回饋懸浮窗。在 Linux 上建議選擇「無」

pasteMethod.title: 貼上方式
pasteMethod.description: 選擇文字插入方式。直接：透過系統輸入模擬打字。無：跳過貼上，僅更新歷史紀錄/剪貼簿

typingTool.title: 輸入工具
typingTool.description: 選擇在直接貼上方式下使用的 Linux 輸入工具。選擇自動會自動偵測並使用系統中可用的最佳工具

clipboardHandling.title: 剪貼簿處理
clipboardHandling.description: 不修改剪貼簿將在轉錄後保留目前剪貼簿內容。複製到剪貼簿會在貼上後將轉錄結果留在剪貼簿中

autoSubmit.title: 自動送出
autoSubmit.description: 插入文字後自動發送指定的按鍵組合。macOS 為 Cmd+Enter，Windows/Linux 為 Super+Enter

translateToEnglish.label: 翻譯為英語
translateToEnglish.description: 在轉錄過程中自動將其他語言的語音翻譯為英語

modelUnload.title: 卸載模型
modelUnload.description: 當模型在指定時間內未使用時自動釋放 GPU/CPU 記憶體

customWords.title: 自訂詞彙
customWords.description: 協助支援的模型辨識名稱和專業術語。目前，模糊修正僅適用於使用 A–Z 字母和數字的詞語。

voiceActivityDetection.title: 語音活動偵測
voiceActivityDetection.description: 過濾錄音中的靜音。支援串流的模型會使用較長的 VAD 尾段；停用 VAD 則會錄製原始音訊

vadBackend.title: 語音活動偵測後端
vadBackend.description: 選擇用於過濾靜音的偵測器。Earshot 為實驗性功能；若語音被截斷或雜訊被保留，請切換回 Silero。

fillerWordRemoval.title: 移除語助詞
fillerWordRemoval.description: 從轉錄中移除常見的語助詞。關閉此選項即可保留這些詞。

chineseScript.title: 繁簡轉換
chineseScript.description: 將國語和粵語轉錄輸出為簡體或繁體中文。其他語言不受影響。

prompts.promptInstructionsPlaceholder: 撰寫轉錄後要執行的指令。範例：改善以下文字的語法和清晰度: ${output}

prompts.createFirst: 點選上方的「建立新提示詞」來建立您的第一個後處理提示詞

local.title: Free local cleanup models
local.intro: Pick a model, press Install, then Use. It runs on your computer. Nothing is sent online and no API key is needed.
local.notRunning: This needs the free Ollama app. Install it, open it once, then come back here. The list below turns on by itself.

qwen3b.name: Qwen 2.5 3B
qwen3b.description: Best balance of quality and speed for cleaning up dictation. Good with mixed languages.

qwen15b.name: Qwen 2.5 1.5B
qwen15b.description: Smallest and fastest. Use this on older or low-memory computers.

llama3b.name: Llama 3.2 3B
llama3b.description: Strong English writing. Slightly slower than Qwen.

gemma2b.name: Gemma 2 2B
gemma2b.description: Compact model from Google. A good second opinion if Qwen is not right.

always.title: Always Clean Up
always.label: Clean up every dictation
always.description: Runs your cleanup prompt on the main hotkey too: fixes punctuation, removes filler words, formats text. Needs a provider and model below. If it fails, raw text is pasted.

contextTone.title: Context Tone
contextTone.label: Match tone to the active app
contextTone.description: Detects the app you are dictating into and adjusts the cleanup style (chat, email, code). Needs post-processing enabled.
contextTone.patternPlaceholder: App or window title contains, e.g. slack
contextTone.tonePlaceholder: Style to apply, e.g. Casual, short, no greeting
contextTone.hint: First matching rule wins. Matches the app name or the window title, so web apps like Gmail work inside a browser. Detection works on Windows, macOS and Linux X11.

builtIn.title: Built-in offline model
builtIn.intro: One click and Oshabe sets up a small AI model on this computer. No account, no API key, no other app. It only runs while it is needed.
builtIn.stepRunner: Step 1 of 2: getting the model runner ({{percent}}%)
builtIn.failed: Could not set up the offline model

userRules.title: My Rules
userRules.description: Standing instructions the AI always follows when it writes for you, for example "Use bullet points" or "Keep summaries under 5 lines". Needs an AI model set up (the built-in one works).

history.title: 歷史紀錄
history.empty: 還沒有轉錄紀錄。開始錄製以建立您的歷史紀錄！
history.copyError: 無法將轉錄複製到剪貼簿。
history.transcriptionFailed: 轉錄失敗。您可以使用重試圖示重新轉錄。

liveLogs.title: 即時日誌
liveLogs.description: 即時串流應用程式日誌，無需開啟日誌檔即可診斷問題。僅顯示此面板開啟期間產生的日誌；遵循上方的「日誌等級」設定。
liveLogs.empty: 正在等待日誌…… 應用程式產生日誌時會顯示於此。

recordingRetention.description: 自動刪除舊錄音以節省空間

alwaysOnMicrophone.description: 保持麥克風啟用以獲得更快的回應

clamshellMicrophone.title: 闔蓋麥克風
clamshellMicrophone.description: 筆記型電腦闔蓋時使用的麥克風

postProcessingToggle.description: 啟用轉錄後的 AI 文字最佳化

pasteDelay.title: 貼上延遲（前）
pasteDelay.description: 複製文字後、發送貼上按鍵前的延遲（毫秒）。如果沒有貼上任何內容，請增加此值。

pasteDelayAfter.title: 貼上延遲（後）
pasteDelayAfter.description: 發送貼上按鍵後、還原先前剪貼簿前的延遲（毫秒）。如果貼上的是舊的剪貼簿內容而非轉錄文字，請增加此值。

holdThreshold.title: 長按判定時長
holdThreshold.description: 僅適用於「自動」模式：快捷鍵需要按住多久（毫秒）才算作按住而不是輕按。如果短暫按住後錄音仍持續，請調低；如果刻意的輕按被視為按住，請調高。

reliablePaste.title: 可靠貼上（Beta）
reliablePaste.description: 在目標應用程式真正讀取轉錄文字之後才還原剪貼簿，而不是等待固定延遲。用於解決系統負載較高時貼上舊剪貼簿內容的問題。需要使用剪貼簿類的貼上方式；僅支援 macOS 與 Windows。

recordingBuffer.title: 額外錄音緩衝
recordingBuffer.description: 放開按鍵後繼續錄音的額外時間（毫秒），以捕捉尾音。0 = 無額外緩衝。

keyboardDiagnostic.title: 鍵盤診斷
keyboardDiagnostic.description: 檢查鍵盤事件是否能送達 Oshabe。只會記錄事件數量，絕不記錄您按了哪些按鍵。
keyboardDiagnostic.running: 正在監聽… 請按幾次您的快捷鍵（例如 Option+Space）
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictBlocked: Secure Input 正在阻擋按鍵事件——在問題解決前，包含一般按鍵的快捷鍵無法運作。
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictSuspicious: 收到了修飾鍵事件，但沒有按鍵事件——即使 Secure Input 回報為已停用，仍有程式在抑制按鍵。請在 GitHub 上回報此問題。
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictOk: 按鍵事件正常送達 Oshabe。
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictNoEvents: 未擷取到任何事件——測試期間您有按鍵嗎？

meetings.title: Meeting notes
meetings.intro: Record a call on this computer and get a transcript and a summary. Works with Zoom, Meet, Teams and anything else that plays sound.
meetings.consent: Tell everyone on the call that you are recording. Some places require consent.
meetings.tipHeadphones: Tip: use headphones so the other side's voice is not picked up by your mic twice.
meetings.summaryNeedsModel: Pick a cleanup model in Post Process (Ollama or another provider) to make summaries.
meetings.summaryAppleUnsupported: Apple Intelligence cannot write meeting summaries. Choose another provider in Post Process.
meetings.summaryNoTranscript: There is no transcript to summarise.
meetings.summaryFailed: Could not make the summary. Your transcript is saved.
meetings.needModel: Download a speech model first in Models.
meetings.transcribeError: Part of the audio could not be transcribed.
meetings.warnSystemAudio: Could not capture the other side's audio. Only your mic is recorded.
meetings.warnMic: Could not open your mic. Only the other side's audio is recorded.
meetings.storageNote: Everything is stored on this computer only. Open a meeting and press Save as Word or Save as PDF to get a file in Documents/Oshabe Meetings.
meetings.promptDescription: When Zoom, Meet, Teams, Webex or a Slack huddle comes to the front, ask if you want notes. Only the app name and window title are checked.
meetings.noSpeech: Nothing was heard, so there is nothing to summarise. Check the level bars while recording: your bar should move when you talk. If it stays flat, pick the right microphone in Settings. Text appears every few seconds after you speak.

templates.label: Summary template
templates.hint: Changes what the summary focuses on. It applies to the next summary you make, including Regenerate.
templates.namePlaceholder: Template name, for example Board meeting
templates.instructionsPlaceholder: What should the summary focus on? For example: list every vote and who proposed it.
